title: SimWorks Studios Details PC-12 Legacy MSFS 2024 Launch, New Installer and Medevac Plans
summary: SimWorks Studios is targeting 30 October for its PC-12 Legacy release in MSFS 2024, with a new installer, virtual passenger smartphone and plans for a Medevac interior.
body:
SimWorks Studios (SWS) has shared further details of its upcoming **Pilatus PC-12 Legacy for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024**, confirming plans for a **30 October 2026 launch** alongside a new installation system and additional aircraft features.

The developer's latest announcements, published through its official Discord community, outline the release arrangements, an enhanced passenger experience and plans for a future medical evacuation cabin configuration.

A promotional image shared on **26 October** carries the message *“4 Days to Release”*, reinforcing the developer's intended launch date.

![](</assets/Image 2-3.jpg>)

## PC-12 Legacy Scheduled for 30 October

The MSFS 2024 edition of the PC-12 Legacy is scheduled to arrive on **Friday, 30 October 2026**, with distribution through SimWorks Studios' new installer.

SWS has confirmed that the new installer is being made available to customers, while the previous version will remain accessible through customer order pages as a fallback.

The developer currently plans to phase out the older installer in January.

The forthcoming PC-12 release is also being supported by a countdown campaign, with daily previews intended to highlight new features developed for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024.

## New Virtual Passenger Smartphone

One of the more unusual additions is a virtual smartphone designed to enhance the passenger experience during longer flights.

Previewed by SWS on **19 October**, the feature allows passengers to engage in activities including minigames and text messaging while travelling aboard the aircraft.

Although primarily an immersion feature, it reflects the developer's efforts to expand the experience beyond the cockpit and introduce additional detail to the aircraft's passenger environment.

SWS has published a short video demonstrating the feature.

[Watch the official PC-12 passenger experience preview](https://youtube.com/shorts/mWRSpa2_rdM?feature=share)

## Medevac Interior Planned

SimWorks Studios has also confirmed that a **Medevac interior** is under development for the PC-12 Legacy.

According to the developer, the medical evacuation configuration is intended to arrive when the aircraft becomes available through the Microsoft Flight Simulator Marketplace, which SWS currently expects approximately two weeks after its initial release.

The Medevac interior was described as being around halfway through development in the 23 October announcement.

This planned addition would extend the PC-12's operational versatility, allowing virtual pilots to recreate medical transport missions alongside conventional passenger and executive flying.

The Medevac configuration is **not confirmed as part of the initial 30 October release**.

![](</assets/Image 4.webp>)

## New SWS Installer and Open Beta Programme

Alongside the aircraft release preparations, SimWorks Studios has introduced a new **Open Beta programme** for customers using its updated installer.

The programme allows owners of eligible aircraft to access forthcoming product updates before their general release.

Customers can opt in through the Beta Testing Access section of their account on the SWS website. Once enabled, available beta versions can be downloaded through the new installer.

Importantly, SWS has clarified that this programme applies **only to products already released**. It does not provide early access to unreleased aircraft, including the forthcoming PC-12 Legacy for MSFS 2024.

The developer says the programme is intended to give customers an opportunity to test upcoming improvements and provide feedback before wider distribution.

## Release Approaching

With its announced launch date just days away, the PC-12 Legacy is shaping up to be an interesting addition to Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024's executive and utility turboprop fleet.

The combination of a dedicated MSFS 2024 release, expanded passenger features and a planned Medevac configuration gives the aircraft potential appeal across several types of virtual aviation operations.

**The PC-12 Legacy remains scheduled for 30 October 2026, subject to final release confirmation from SimWorks Studios.**

BizJet Pilot will continue monitoring the developer's announcements and will report on the aircraft's availability once its release is confirmed.
